resources.string: Fixulator needs one permission from Android to process sound from other apps. Three quick steps, all on this phone. You must be on Wi-Fi.
Tap the button, find \"Build number\" (on some phones under Software information, or \"Version\") and tap it 7 times. Then come back here.
Tap the button, find \"Wireless debugging\" and switch it on (answer Allow). Then come back here.
Tap Start. In Wireless debugging, tap \"Pair device with pairing code\". A Fixulator notification appears: pull it down, tap \"Enter code\" and type the 6 digits shown. Fixulator does the rest.
Now tap \"Pair device with pairing code\", then type the code in the Fixulator notification.
Use another method instead (Shizuku or computer) ›
Waiting… In Wireless debugging, tap \"Pair device with pairing code\".
Pairing code ready. Tap \"Enter code\" and type the 6 digits.
Didn\'t work (%1$s). Open the pairing dialog again and enter the new code.
Done! You can switch Wireless debugging off again. Tap to open Fixulator.
